messages.text: I found the Rockville photo envelope. You in that blue dress, me missing a front tooth, Ba's tool case half open behind us.
That was the hallway by the stairs, right before my 16th birthday dinner. Ma had just taken in the hem because I kept stepping on it.
And Ba made us stand still because he had balanced the camera on that little black meter box from his workbench.
He also checked our homework before cake. Very on brand for that house.
Con, the portal has new blood paper. One number has a red arrow. I do not know if I should change the evening pill.
Please keep taking it the same way until the nurse calls back. I will ask Linh to check the portal after her morning meeting.
I can wait. You have your office numbers this week too, yes?
Yes, but I can call you at 6:40 tonight. Put the paper by the phone so we can read it together.
Con, you still have lemongrass in freezer? I found the good fish sauce at Hung Phat.
Yes, and Ruwan soaked the red lentils this morning. We are doing ca kho and parippu on Sunday.
Good. Make extra for two lunches, not too salty for him.
I wrote it on the container lids this time: mine spicy, his mild, two small rice boxes.
I found the old 2011 go-live binder while clearing my office. Your tab on GL mapping still has five colors of sticky notes.
Please tell me the suspense account page did not survive.
It did. Also the page where you wrote, very small, "worth the detour if I learn the whole machine."
That little sentence talked me into more late nights than I want to admit.
I read your notes on the Denver role. Good scope, but ask who owns the audit committee deck and the capital plan before you get too charmed.
That is exactly the missing piece. I do not want another role where I clean up the numbers and someone else tells the story.
Then your Saturday study block and the ledger article both need to turn into talking points, not just private homework.
Agreed. I marked the sections on consolidation and tokenized receivables so I can explain them without sounding dazzled.
I found a quiet slot at the tea shop after Saturday yoga, 10:45. Just us if that helps.
I saw the Susquehanna ridge loop changed to 8:30 on Saturday. Did you catch the notice?
That sounds right. I turned down the big dinner thread for Friday and would rather keep Saturday simple.
Yes, the Bel Air trail group posted it under events. I marked it and sent it to Ruwan too.
Good. Bring the shoulder stretch questions and the budget-season sighs, but only the ones you want to say out loud.
Good. Also, your balcony basil clip made me want to restart mine.
That one came from the photo grid. I saved it between a Danang food post and a very dry cash-flow dashboard account.
Thank you. I was going to call you instead of typing into the group chat anyway.
Con ơi, form hỏi nơi sinh của con. Mẹ nhớ bệnh viện gần Georgia Ave, đúng không?
Con, today I go CVS after lunch. The parking lot is big. Maybe I wait for Linh?
Dạ, cứ ghi Silver Spring. Con sẽ kiểm tra lại bản copy cũ tối nay.
If Linh cannot go, call me before you leave and I will stay on the phone while you park and walk in.
I saw another short video from cousin's chat. They say take ginger water before the new shot.
Mẹ để sẵn giấy của ba mẹ trong ngăn kéo. Dòng country của ba mẹ vẫn ghi Việt Nam như trước.
Do not change anything from that clip. I will look at the clinic page and send you the plain instructions tonight.
Okay, con sẽ dịch phần hướng dẫn rồi gọi mẹ sau bữa tối.
Con, I found the old folder with Ba and me papers from 1983. Do you need it for your volunteer form?
Maybe just the dates. The form has a page for unusual official incidents in the household, and ours is blank except my old Rockville speeding stop and the insurance report from the parking-lot bump.
Good. I keep the folder with tax papers. Bring it back when you visit.
I will. I can scan the 1983 certificates and leave the rest of that page as N/A.
Con, I found old picture from College Park ceremony. You have blue hood and Ba is holding flowers.
Please keep it aside. That was the May when I thought I could live on coffee and spreadsheet models.
Ba said when we first came here, we did not know what that school was. Then our daughter walked there in cap.
I remember him telling every auntie about the night classes even before I finished.
Would you rather do Ma & Pa Trail before tea on Saturday? The woods should be less muddy by then.
Yes, that sounds good. I need to be back by noon because the lender portal is only open for my call window.
No problem. We can keep it short and start from Williams Street.
Perfect. I also want to stop for seed trays after tea before Ruwan uses the car.
I saw the county agenda item you mentioned. The 988 handoff piece is more practical than the shouting online made it sound.
That is what caught my eye too. I sent the link to the lunch group at work because it felt like something we could discuss without turning it into a fight.
Good. Also, the clinic where I volunteer still keeps a one-page list of groups taking small monthly gifts if you want local names.
Please send it. I already picked two Baltimore-area ones from the hearing notes, but I want to compare before the 15th.
I put the rice cooker insert by the sink. You only sent Linh three words, so I can take dishes tonight.
Please start them. I am still staring at the spreadsheet.
Tea is next to your laptop. We can do the neighborhood loop after dinner and keep it quiet.
That sounds right. I will close this file by 7.
Did you ever finish the comp worksheet for the leadership program application?
Almost. I used 12.5 for my latest before-deductions line so the benefits calculator would stop yelling at me.
Good. Use real numbers, not aspirational fog. Finance people are allowed to be precise.
Precise enough that I also checked whether the Feb car work made our sheet look noisier than it really was.
I put rice on warm. Are you still with the two spreadsheet people and the systems person?
Yes, last pass. I am trying to send them home before I close my own file.
That makes 46 hours before Saturday, by your kitchen calendar. Come home after this version.
I will. No extra contract invoices waiting for me, at least, just this one inbox.
Ma says if we buy the yellow blossoms, not the pink ones, she will stop inspecting our shopping photos like a customs officer.
Yellow blossoms, red envelopes, and the square cakes from Eden Center. I wrote it down exactly.
Are you still making a spreadsheet for the county packet? Please tell me there are colors.
Only three tabs. People, county questions, and notes from the forum.
Good. Also she wants the kids to say the greeting in her words first, before they start asking what is in the envelopes.
Of course. I was going to read mine in the parking lot like a normal chaos person.
I will practice it with them on FaceTime. No one is mumbling through Ma's favorite line this year.
I am stopping at McFaul right after yoga tomorrow. Then it is off my list before work gets loud.
Con got mail from election office? Do not leave on kitchen table too long.
I opened it this morning. I am reading the county guide after tea, especially the bond questions and the clinic item.
Con oi, the pharmacy paper says wait after the needle. Fifteen minutes?
Good. Your father always checked twice before marking anything.
Yes, Ma. Sit there the full 15, and show them your Medicare card. I checked the county page and it matches what Dr. Le's office told Linh.
My arm may hurt again?
Maybe a little. Drink water after. If anything feels unusual, call the nurse line instead of guessing.
I know. I still hear him asking who will pay for it and who will make sure it happens.
Before you lock the roof quote, run the household tab through your dull spreadsheet. Dull is underrated.
Already did. The baseline column stays green through 8 and most of 9, assuming mortgage, utilities, groceries, insurance, and Mom trips only.
Good. Then decide on the roof from the bid quality, not from the Saturday panic price.
Exactly. I am waiting for the second estimate and leaving the bank rule alone.
I can do Ma & Pa Trail at 9:15 if you still want the flatter loop.
Yes, flatter is good. I already did the cuff and wrote down sleep hours, so I can leave by 8:55.
Perfect. We will keep it easy and stretch calves after.
Thank you. Ruwan packed almonds, and I have salmon marinating for dinner after we get back.
Weather looks dry by 10. Annie's Playground loop should be firm enough if we stay off the muddy side path.
That sounds right. I want the trees and gravel, not a cafe catch-up.
I will bring tea for after. Leave the earbuds in the car if you want the full reset.
Already planned. My shoulders finally dropped last time when I did it that way.
Tea after yoga was good. Please do the shoulder stretch before you fold into the sofa tonight.
I will. I have soup warming, then I am putting on the quiet Yo-Yo Ma list and keeping the house dim.
That sounds better than scrolling through spreadsheets until bedtime.
Agreed. I left my book on the armrest so I do not drift back to the laptop.
Auntie Hoa put the temple lunch flyer in the family thread again. Mom wants you to see the parking note.
I saw it. I also clicked the county Vietnamese spring cleanup event from the same place.
Do not wander into the shouting app after that. I sent you a screenshot and already regretted opening it.
I am staying with the auntie updates and event pages. The fast-posting app can stay buried in the folder.
Your post draft on month-end automation is sharp. Cut the third paragraph; nobody needs a sermon before coffee.
Fair. I also want to add one line about making sure junior analysts get training before the new close tools land.
Yes. Tie it to the rollout, not charity. People listen when it sounds like risk control.
Good point. I'll revise after I finish the worksheet examples for Wednesday's group.
Tea after yoga still good for 10:45? I can keep it low-key if you had another short night.
Yes, low-key is perfect. March always makes me check every doctor bill twice and then I lie awake doing math.
Bring the notebook if you want. We can walk first, then tea, and no fixing required.
Thank you. The old spiral from 2017 has a few names tucked inside it, just in case I need more than walking.
I watered the back pots before leaving. The mint is already pushing into the next container.
The Rock Hall inn has a two-night opening June 12-14. Nothing fancy, but it is close to the public ramp.
Of course it is. I will clip some for the broth tonight and move the lemongrass closer to the sun.
That timing works better than taking extra PTO. I can leave after the Friday closeout call.
Good. If your throat is still scratchy after lunch, make the ginger tea and still call the nurse line before dinner.
I will check whether they have space to rinse gear before we put it back on the car.
Already steeping a mug. I will call if it does not settle.
Please also see if Sunday checkout can be early enough for us to miss the bridge traffic.
I put the Home Depot receipt on your desk. It was the garden hose and two bags of soil.
Thanks. I will split it between yard and repairs when I update the March tabs tonight.
Should I move my half for the car insurance now, or wait until the paycheck lands Tuesday?
Tuesday is fine. I already set the draft for Friday and left enough in the green account.
I looked at the Colombo connection again. The longer layover is less elegant, but it gives us breathing room.
I put both versions in the sheet. I also left three afternoons blank so we are not marching ourselves through the whole thing.
Good. Did the March Ally move clear, or should I wait before pricing the kayak weekend?
It cleared this morning. Check the quiet cabin near Cambridge, but no prepaid rate yet.
Con found old school loan paper in my drawer. It says final notice from years ago. Keep or shred?
Take a photo for me first, please. If it is the one stamped paid in full, I can file the scan and you can shred it.
Good. Better less paper. You still come Sunday after church traffic?
Yes. I am keeping Sunday simple so we can do your forms and still get home before the house draft hits Monday.
Con, MyChart asks me about the new cream again. I don't know which button.
Send me the screenshot. I have your login note in the green folder, unless it slid under the envelopes by the kettle.
I send. Also the insurance paper you said to keep, is it same folder?
Yes, same folder. I will update the medicine list tonight and compare it with the March tab.
Did you run the numbers before saying yes to the recruiter coffee? The March 2019 start date is worth more than nostalgia.
I know. The extra vacation tier, match, and two home days are all in my comparison tab.
Add the boring lines too: paycheck premiums, pharmacy, teeth, eyes. Glamorous, I know.
Already there. Ruwan asked me to include the HSA transfer before I pretend the offer is simple.
Did your VP group survive the Tableau waterfall, or did someone ask why the cash line moved after lunch?
They asked. I walked them from bookings to collections and kept the SAP tie-out on the backup slide.
Of course you did. You never let a pretty chart outrun the source table.
Pretty charts are allowed after the rows agree.
Are you making one of your tiny grocery itineraries again, or can I call you for Mom's form?
Call in ten. I am putting the herbs and roasted squash into containers before Ruwan gets home.
Of course you are. Is this for the lentil thing or the noodle bowls?
Both, if the broth behaves. Friday is the restaurant with the menu that lists the growers, so I want the earlier nights handled.
Mom asked why you saved the Friday dressy jacket. I said probably one of your downtown nights with assigned seats.
Yes, the one at Meyerhoff. We booked it early so we would not talk ourselves into staying home.
Very you. Also, if you are checking the orange-and-black score at dinner, at least pretend to listen to Ruwan.
Only between courses. I already put the phone face down during the program.
The Havre de Grace path looks dry by Saturday morning. Want the shorter loop before tea?
Yes, shorter loop is better after this week. I can be there by 8:30 with the small pack.
Good. Also, Nate asked whether you still have your glove for the low-key June evenings.
It is in the garage bin with the old cleats. I will bring it if the same people are doing it again.
Did Ruwan see the portal message too, or am I sending it only to you?
Send it to me. He is fixing the loose cabinet hinge before his 1:00 call.
Of course he is. If you go quiet tonight, let him run the grocery list instead of rewriting it three times.
Fair. We already split dinner and errands for later.
Can I steal twenty minutes at 10:00, or is your Wednesday wall still up?
Wall is up until 11:30. I am reconciling the SAP pull before anyone starts adding questions.
Good. Protect the math before the parade arrives.
After that I have to enter the PECO amount in YNAB and find the bill that is somewhere under the kitchen stack.
Auntie Hoa sent another screenshot saying the county clinic is hiding side effects. Mom asked me if she should cancel Tuesday.
Mom found the folder with both spellings of Ba's middle name. Of course there are two versions.
Please tell Mom to keep Tuesday for now. I am checking the patient portal and the county clinic page, not the screenshot.
Please send me the clear photo. I need the one that matches my Silver Spring certificate.
Also Mom wants one of us with her at the farmers market. She said the videos from 2020 are in her head again.
Sent. Also, Mom said you corrected her English line-by-line last time, so you're elected again.
I can do the market at 9:00 and then we can sit with her over tea. Send me the clinic screenshot separately so I can compare the wording.
Fair. I can explain it to her in our usual mix after dinner tomorrow.
Con, when you come Sunday bring the black thread box. The beaded sleeve on Linh's dress is loose.
I have it. Do you also want the little chalk wheel from the Rockville sewing table?
Yes. Also the ruler with inches. Your father kept my good one near his soldering things and never put it back.
I remember. Same table where we had to finish homework before TV.
Con, Saturday bring the small incense bowl from my cabinet. The one with blue flowers.
Yes, Ma. I will wrap it in a towel and bring the orange box too.
Good. Do not put the fruit lower than the photo. Your ba always said that looked careless.
I remember. Fruit high, tea cups in front, and the rice dish on the right.
Beth asked whether you are coming to Towson on the 20th. I told her three seats, not ten.
Perfect. You, Beth, and me is the version I can actually enjoy after close.
Excellent. No audience, no performance, and no stray spreadsheet philosophers.
Also, if the week goes sideways, I may call you before dinner instead of writing a long complaint anywhere public.
For the Thursday deck, do not let IT rewrite the story. Let the numbers people prove the bridge and let operations speak to volume.
That is the plan. I have Rosa on bridge support, Elena on checks, and Jamal for volume.
Good. Also, if payroll asks again, your 0.0 overtime line is boring but correct.
They asked because the late nights are obvious. I told them the same home cost center and no second form.
If the budget deck is still glaring at you, close it before it starts making decisions.
I closed it. Going to the 6:15 floor class and then a lap around the neighborhood before opening email again.
Good. Numbers improve when their owner stops clenching her jaw.
Budget week is trying to steal your whole evening. Close the file before it starts negotiating.
I am closing it at 6:30. Dinner, then the BSO recording you sent last month at low volume.
Phone will stay in my coat pocket for that lap. I need the street sounds more than another podcast.
Good. Let Marin Alsop do the arguing for once.
Perfect. If I keep the phone in the kitchen, I may actually finish a few pages later.
Did the community room meeting get intense, or was it mostly crosswalks and porch lights?
Mostly crosswalks, porch lights, and people asking about car break-ins. I realized my examples were just two pulled-over moments and that little fender-bender report.
That sounds like enough civic homework for one week. Tea after yoga Saturday?
Yes. Also relieved I did not need to dig up anything from Mom, Linh, or Ruwan for the sign-in notes.
I left coffee by your notebook. Is tonight still your practice questions night, or did the promotion-panel prep move there?
Both, unfortunately. Thirty questions first, then I rehearse the cash-flow answer before dinner.
I can handle groceries after work. You should not be comparing vendor buzzwords at 10 p.m. again.
Thank you. I only need to finish the smart-contract controls note so I can use it as an example, not a rabbit hole.
I put soup on low. Are you still untangling the investment deck?
Almost done. The return case changed when I swapped in the new Oracle export and updated the risk notes.
That explains the quiet. Did Mark ask you to give the final version?
Yes, after I flag the two assumptions that do not trace cleanly.
I added the consulting deposit to the shared sheet. The two top lines come to 22.0 before deductions this cycle.
Thank you. That leaves room for the roof reserve even after the Bel Air Auto charge cleared.
Yes. I would still cook tonight instead of ordering again; the sheet looks better when we do not nickel-and-dime it.
Agreed. I bought bok choy and salmon, so no excuse.
I put rice on warm and moved the recycling bins. You were very quiet when you came in.
Thank you. The budget deck changed again, and I still have Ma's form open on the laptop. I need to say out loud that I cannot do all of it tonight.
Then do not. Eat first, send Linh one clear list, and we can take the neighborhood loop before the rain starts.
That is the order I needed. I will close the spreadsheet at 9:30 even if it is not pretty.
I saved you a bowl of curry. How did Room 2B go?
Lively. The teens cared most about first paychecks, and the older table had many questions about fake bank texts.
That sounds useful. Did your two analysts get their questions in afterward?
Yes. I told them to ask for the SAP class now, while the rollout calendar still has budget attached.
Mom found the old Da Nang address card. She says not to trust it unless Auntie Lan confirms.
Perfect. I am adding it as a maybe, not a fixed stop. We can ask after her appointment Tuesday.
Mom wants to know if you still have the framed paper with the red seal. She wants to show Co Hoa on Sunday.
It is in the office closet behind the tax files. Please do not let her take it to dim sum.
Look at you, making a maybe column. Growth.
Too late, she is already rehearsing the part about you reading case packets after helping translate Dad's benefits forms.
The sheet has a tab for Maybes and a tab for Costs. I am containing myself.
That story gets longer every year, but she is allowed one dramatic version.
Con, should I bring my small pillow tomorrow?
Bring it if it helps your neck. I washed the sheets on the office daybed last night.
I will bring cha lua too. Your yard has room for herbs now?
Yes, the back bed is ready. Ruwan trimmed the branches so the basil should get more morning sun.
Did you survive the packet chase, or are you still hunting 1099s like it is a quarter close?
Almost done. I have the Vanguard forms, the mortgage interest form, and Ruwan's consulting summary in one folder for Anita.
Naturally you built a folder hierarchy. Please tell me you also saved the prior-year organizer.
Yes, and I added the Maryland estimate notes so we do not miss the same question again.
You skipped the 4:30 prep call. Please tell me it was for something more useful than another reconciliation rabbit hole.
Still on for 6:45? I checked the menu. They are very proud of those Harford County mushrooms.
CVS had an opening, and Dr. Tran's message said this week made sense before the April travel stretch.
Yes. Ruwan and I used up the last soup jars this week, so a real dinner out sounds good.
Excellent. I may order the Chenin by the glass unless the meeting gods have ruined my palate.
Acceptable excuse. I assume you read the boring official pages first, because you are you.
Maryland update, Hopkins summary, and my portal note. Then I booked it.
I might share a pour with dinner. Mostly going for the spring vegetables and not thinking about spreadsheets.
Trail tomorrow still works. Also, I saw the county forum link you sent. You had margin notes all over that PDF.
Yes. The clean-water section sounded right, but I wanted to see the capital schedule and maintenance costs before I trusted the applause lines.
That is very you. I only skimmed the parts about transit access and the health van.
Those matter too. I just wish every proposal came with a staffing table and quarterly metrics.
I started the rice and cut the bok choy. Do you want cod or tofu tonight?
Cod, please. I sat too long today, so a short walk after dinner would help.
Good. We can do the quiet loop, twenty minutes. Your pill organizer is still on the counter.
Thanks for noticing. I will take tonight's small one before we head out.
Are you bringing the folding table to Mom's or should I borrow one from Thao?
We can bring ours. It seats six if we squeeze, but at home Ruwan and I only keep the two everyday place mats out.
Of course you have place mats assigned like a spreadsheet.
Laugh all you want. One side has the nuoc cham bowl, one side has the sambol bowl, and no one gets confused.
Con xem giay bao hiem nay giup Me duoc khong? They ask again about medicine list.
Send me a photo. I will put it in the binder with Ba's 2017 hospital papers so everything stays together.
You keep too much paper, but it helped before. Do not stay up late for this.
I will stop by 8. If I start carrying it into our house again, Ruwan already has permission to point me back to the old card.
The conference hotel is pushing the upgraded suite again. Classic.
I booked the normal room. I would rather keep the reimbursed difference available for a later flight change if Mom needs me.
Sensible. The suite will not improve the panel, despite what the carpet thinks.
Exactly. Also, I am sending my card receipt after it closes; it will clear from checking before the cycle rolls.
Still up for the short Ma & Pa trail before tea, or did budget week eat Saturday too?
Trail, yes. Tea, yes. I skipped the garden center detour after the app moved the March amount overnight.
That sounds like you protected future-Hanh from present-Hanh wanting new planters.
Future-Hanh is annoyingly persuasive. I will bring the cinnamon tea coupon instead.
Tea after yoga still works? I can bring that little jar of balm you liked for your shoulders.
Yes. I am slow today, so tea sounds better than a long walk.
No long walk, then. Warm cup, gentle stretches, and you can tell me whether the basil starts survived the cold snap.
They are hanging on. I covered them and moved the mint tray inside last night.
I set the Towson reservation for 7:15. Is this the dinner where Marcia returns your ancient binder?
Yes. She says it still has my comparison sheet between the comfortable controller opening and the messy ledger project.
The messy one bought you a very durable map of how money moves through a company.
It also bought us many takeout dinners that year. I will not romanticize the whole thing.
Mom says you sounded tired. Did you still go out with your boot people yesterday?
Only the Havre de Grace stretch, nothing dramatic. I was home before lunch.
Did you mean to send me that receipt screenshot? It had Baltimore Community Bail Fund and MVLS on it.
Boot people is my official name for them. Are these the same ones who drag you to that dusty summer field?
Yes, but mostly so you could tell me whether the employer match portal looks normal. I do not want to click the wrong category.
Some overlap. Mostly Priya, Nate, and whoever answers the thread.
The category is fine. Also your notes in the margin about 911 calls with no weapon made me laugh because of course you turned a public meeting into a spreadsheet.
A small spreadsheet. I wanted to separate the complaint-review items from the mobile-team items before the next comment period.
If we walk the Ma & Pa trail Saturday morning, will you still have enough energy for your evening downtown plan?
Yes. It is seated, and I already moved dinner earlier because the downbeat is 8:00.
Good. Sunday is the purple crowd on TV at our house if you and Ruwan want to stop by after tea.
Maybe for the second half. Ruwan will bring the shortbread if we come.
For July, Eastern Neck has an easy flat loop and a quiet trail if you want both in one morning.
That sounds like our speed. We are trying to keep these to one overnight, maybe two at most.
Then skip the big rental houses. A small place near Chestertown would keep the drive reasonable.
Good point. I mainly want calm water, a walk, and not a production.
I put the CVS receipt by your laptop. $11 today, and the refill shows 90 days.
Thanks. I will enter it with the dental estimate and the glasses line after dinner.
Also, your HR email came through about the anniversary PTO bump. We can look after our walk.
Good. I want the whole March tab updated before payroll closes Friday.
I saw your printed guide on the kitchen table. Do you still need the laptop tonight?
Maybe twenty minutes. I want to compare the charter wording with the county explainer before I mark the last two boxes.
No hurry. I will start the rice and leave your notes where they are.
Thank you. If the Bel Air office is quiet Friday morning, I can finish on the way to Mom's.
I uploaded the insurance letter and left a message for the nurse. You can stop refreshing the portal now, chi.
Caught. I checked it between two budget calls and knew that was not useful.
Your assignment is lunch and one walk around the building. Mine is the callback. Ma's assignment is not changing anything until we hear back.
Deal. I will call Ma after 6 and only ask her to read me the pill bottle once.
You went quiet after the portal message. Call me after dishes?
Yes. I almost typed a whole thing into that neighborhood thread and then deleted it.
Good. Me, Ruwan, Priya, Marcia, Beth. Pick an actual person, not a scrolling room.
Calling you at 8:40. I do better when the list stays short.
I sent you the ERP dashboard article. Ignore the comment swarm under the headline unless you need a migraine.
Thank you. I found the article account through my photo app, where it sits beside dumpling videos and raised-bed tomatoes.
That is a more civilized neighborhood for data quality.
Exactly. The short-post place turns every system issue into twenty hot takes before lunch.
Mom says you want her 1983 certificate scan AND the Geico PDF. Why are these in the same folder, chị?
Because the volunteer packet asked for old official-contact examples. Mine are boring: the Route 1 stop, the Rockville stop, and the 2022 bump report.
Very you to make a tidy archive for three boring things.
I put N/A for immediate family on the other lines, so I only need Mom's scan to confirm the date on her certificate.
Con co den nha me sau 11 khong?
Yes. I am making one stop in Bel Air first. I have my license and the marked paper with me.
Good. Di som cho khoe. Me se nau canh chua.
Perfect. I should be done quickly if the line is short.
You went silent after the audit call. Data quality sins are not worth losing dinner over.
I know. It hit the same nerve as the hospital billing maze in 2017: if I miss one detail, someone pays for it.
That instinct made you good at systems. It does not require you to be on duty at 2 a.m.
Fair. If it keeps turning into 2 a.m. or short answers at home, I will use the referral list instead of pretending tea fixes everything.
Tea after yoga tomorrow? I can bring the article about how false posts jump from small groups into neighborhood pages.
Yes. That pattern has bothered me since case-count rumors were flying around and then those Capitol clips in January.
I remember. Bring the printed notes if you want; we can walk after and let your shoulders come down.
I will. I am also making Mom a one-page version of the clinic guidance so she does not keep re-reading family screenshots.
The servicer posted the March draft. It matches the number in our spreadsheet.
Good. I will file the receipt after work with the Bel Air utilities folder.
Also, my sister may come the first weekend in April. I can fold your monitor arm down if she uses that room.
Thanks. I will clear the tax folders from the desk and leave the trail maps in the basket.
I put the framed Rockville picture on the dining table. Your father is holding a circuit board in the corner; I had not noticed that before.
That was probably after he fixed Mrs. Tran's radio. Ma was pinning someone's prom skirt in the next room.
The photo feels very orderly. You and Linh are lined up by height, and everyone looks ready five minutes early.
That was how weekends ran there: chores first, shoes by the door, no surprises.
Con nhớ đem lá chuối đông lạnh ra sớm. Bánh chưng không gói khi lá còn cứng.
I put them in the sink already. I also saved the cilantro stems for the stock.
Good. Add fish sauce later, not early. If Ruwan coughs again, make ginger slices with hot water first.
I will. His appointment is Monday, so today is just warm drinks and soup.
For Thursday's panel, use the systems-conversion story, not the tidy resume version.
For Thursday's panel, use the posting-rule story. People understand broken invoices faster than polished slides.
The one where I spent three weekends with procurement, AP, and the plant accountant chasing a three-cent variance?
The untidy version includes night seminars, my mother's sewing invoices, and me learning variance analysis at the kitchen table.
Exactly. Then say what you learned from being close enough to the screens to smell the bad master data.
Exactly. It explains why your finance answers never sound theoretical.
That story still explains half my opinions about fancy dashboards.
I will keep it concise. No one needs a fifteen-minute history before coffee.
